title: Resolve reusable assignments in planning views
description: Complete planning integration with reusable advisory tasks. Ensure planning create, list, show, update, and set-status views resolve reusableTaskIds against one current catalog snapshot, preserve assignment order, reflect later definition renames/title/instruction edits, and reject manually corrupted missing references during store loads. Planning mutations must share the existing global locking and reusable catalog validation semantics. Do not add new reusable CRUD or execute advisory instructions. Add focused tests for zero/one/many assignments, replacement/clear/reorder, live edits, Unicode instructions, deleted-definition corruption, and unchanged executable-task behavior.
